source = '''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))\n    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2)\n    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (2, background)]\n    top = min(r for r, _ in points)\n    bottom = max(r for r, _ in points)\n    height = bottom - top + 1\n    target = divider - height - 1 if bottom < divider else divider + height + 1\n    out[target] = [8] * len(grid[0])\n    return out\n'''
